sn35.32:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ– sabbamaññitasamugghātasappāyaṃ vo bhikkhave, paṭipadaṃ desissāmi.
sn35.32:1.3: katamā ca sā bhikkhave, sabbamaññitasamugghātasappāya paṭipadā:
sn35.32:4.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti?
sn35.32:6.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallannu taṃ samanupassituṃ
sn35.32:6.2: etaṃ mama eso’hamasmi, so me attāti?
sn35.32:8.1: rūpā niccā vā aniccā vāti? aniccā bhante. yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti? dukkhaṃ bhante. yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ viparināmadhammaṃ kallannu taṃ samanupassituṃ “etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attā”ti? no hetaṃ bhante.
sn35.32:8.2: cakkhuviññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti? aniccaṃ bhante. yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti? dukkhaṃ bhante. yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallannu taṃ samanupassituṃ: “etaṃ mama eso’hamasmi, eso me attā”ti? no hetaṃ bhante.
sn35.32:9.1: anicco bhante. yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti? dukkhaṃ bhante. yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallannu taṃ samanupassituṃ “etaṃ mama eso’hamasmi, eso me attā”ti? no hetaṃ bhante.
sn35.32:10.1: yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, tampi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti?
sn35.32:12.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti?

sn35.32:16.1: jivhā niccā vā aniccā vā ti? aniccā bhante. yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti?

sn35.32:28.1: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati, rūpesupi nibbindati, cakkhuviññāṇepi nibbindati, cakkhusamphassepi nibbindati.
sn35.32:28.2: yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tasmimpi nibbindati …pe…
sn35.32:28.3: jivhāyapi nibbindati, rasesupi nibbindati, jivhāviññāṇepi nibbindati, jivhāsamphassepi nibbindati, yampidaṃ jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tasmimpi nibbindati. …pe…
sn35.32:28.4: manasmimpi nibbindati, dhammesupi nibbindati, manoviññāṇepi nibbindati, manosamphassepi nibbindati.
sn35.32:28.5: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tasmimpi nibbindati.
sn35.32:28.6: nibbindaṃ virajjati, virāgā vimuccati, vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn35.32:28.7: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
sn35.32:28.8: ayaṃ kho sā bhikkhave, sabbamaññitasamugghāta sappāyapaṭipadāti.
